tests.title: parses shorthand and named float options with native ranges and refuses everything else with exact messages
computes the ring length with float lrintf (round half to even) and refuses a zero-length ring
refuses mono, multichannel and masked layouts and requires a configured format for empty input
negotiates packed float for every input format, keeps counts and declares the ring as state
matches a direct C transcription across options, rates and frame splits, without touching input frames
converts integer and planar input to packed float and enforces allocation, format and cancellation limits
matches native framecrc bytes for delay 1/20/100 ms at 8000/44100/48000 Hz across option sweeps, sources and f32/s16 outputs
matches native raw and WAV bytes for shorthand options, asetnsamples splits, composed chains and output time selection
fails explicitly before output for mono and masked input, native option errors and unimplemented forms

details: 252 framecrc byte comparisons: delay {1,20,100} ms x rates {8000,44100,48000} x option sweeps (4 for s16le/f32le, 2 for u8/s32le/f64le) x pcm_f32le/pcm_s16le outputs, -cpuflags 0, stereo raw input of 6000 samples (linux/x64 gated)

180 byte comparisons: raw s16le 44100, raw f32le 48000 and WAV input x 12 chains (shorthand, asetnsamples splits before/after, stacked stereowiden, volume float/fixed, apad, aformat=s32) x 5 outputs (f32le, s16le, -ss/-t, -frames:a 2 framecrc, s16 framecrc) (linux/x64 gated)

18 native exit statuses for refusals: 8 out-of-range (222), 2 syntax (234), unknown option (8), zero-length ring at 500 Hz (234), FL+FC mask (234); mono, three channels, enable, expression and DL+DR mask where native succeeds (0) and we refuse before output

unsupported: mono, multichannel and non-default WAV/W64 masks (native converts implicitly)
automatic sample-rate conversion inside the chain
byte-exact claims off linux/x64 (native may contract the formula into fma)

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 46 s, npm ci 10 s, reference:build 183 s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+unit 156 s.
Ring length uses fround(fround(fround(delay)*fround(rate))/1000) with round-half-even lrintf, then *2 floats; 0 is refused in constraint() like native EINVAL.
reserve() declares one output frame plus stateBytes = length*4.
No shared edits beyond the registry line were needed.
